A separately authorized exact request returned HTTP 200 with a complete 404 Error Page and Requested Page Not Found (404) text. No robots directives were received and no positive robots grant is claimed. There was no authentication, crawler challenge, access denial or further redirect. A single identified source HTML request is approved; no workaround, automatic redirect, retry or bulk crawl is authorized.
